# Get Device Details

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Retrieves a detail about the device.

## Syntax

~~~~text
deviceDetails(detail: <#Enumeration (WFDeviceDetail)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
deviceDetails(detail: Device Name)
~~~~
